_meta.note: 21 Artificial Analysis links. Model pages: currentModel RSC objects (slug-anchored) mapped to the current ids; only rows the DB lacked are added. GPT-6 Sol/Luna tier scores were already stored (S282, identical on re-read); their speed/latency/time-per-task fields drifted (volatile, S282 snapshot kept). Kept, not overwritten: Opus 5.5 HLE from Anthropic's card (64.4 max) vs AA's run (61.35); Grok 4 HLE 40.0 vs AA 26.69. Articles add the Grok Build Coding Agent Index (Grok 4.7 56, Grok 4.6 xhigh 47) and its components; Opus 5.5 article figures match the payload. Withheld: AA-Briefcase analytical/presentation sub-Elos (no ids).
